[Consultancy]{.eyebrow}

# Consultancy

Alongside my research I take on a limited amount of consultancy — mostly **data analysis** for teams that already have the data.

::: {.offer-lead}
### Data analysis
You have the data — from a study, a hospital system, a survey — and you want answers you can rely on. I take it from raw data to a clear, defensible result: the right model, reproducible code, and a plain account of what it does and does not support.
:::

I also help with the work around the analysis:

:::: {.offers}

::: {.offer}
### Study & survey design
Sample size and measurement choices, so the data can answer the question later.
:::

::: {.offer}
### Instrument validation & psychometrics
Factor structure, reliability and measurement invariance for questionnaires and scales.
:::

::: {.offer}
### Simulation & health economics
Patient-flow and capacity modelling, agent-based simulation, cost-effectiveness.
:::

::: {.offer}
### Review & second opinion
An independent read of an analysis before submission, or after a reviewer's report.
:::

::::
